title: Baguette Halo Drops
category: Earrings (pearl drop: baguette sunburst disc on a post, pearl swings below)
metal: 18k gold tone (listing: 'PVD 18K gold coating'); bright high-polish rim, loop and bell cap, matte granular gold in the channels and on the spokes between the stones. One tone only; base metal not stated in the listing.
lock: 2 earrings, each a 27 mm drop on a post. Top: 1 flat 14 mm disc, plain polished rim; inside, 20 tapered clear baguette cubic zirconia set radially like a sunburst, gold beads between their ends; centre: 1 small 5 mm white pearl in an open window on 4 short spokes. Below, from 1 loop and a bell cap, hangs 1 round 9.5 mm white pearl. The disc must stay 20 radial baguettes pointing in at a small centre pearl, never round pave, a round diamond centre or baguettes laid end to end around the rim. Metal: 18k gold tone, high polish rim with matte textured gold between the stones.
morph: The disc. Because the title says 'halo', image models redraw it as a classic halo: a round brilliant diamond or big round stone in the middle with small round pave stones around it, or they lay the baguettes end to end around the rim like a baguette hoop. They also drop or close the small centre pearl (fill the open window, swap the pearl for a stone), lose count (12 or 30 slivers instead of 20), and turn the tapered sunburst into a flower. Second risk: the drop pearl grows bigger than the disc or becomes a teardrop; it is a round pearl about 2/3 the disc's width, on a small bell cap, and it hangs free.
sizeMm: Total drop 27 mm, disc 14 mm across (listing size guide, 'give or take 1 mm'). From the size guide I estimate: drop pearl about 9.5 mm (2/3 of the disc width), centre pearl about 5 mm (1/3 of the disc), loop and bell cap about 3.5 mm. Each baguette is about 2.5 mm long. Body referent: in worn photo 02 the disc sits on the earlobe and covers most of it, and the pearl hangs just below the lobe. The disc is about a thumbnail wide, and the whole earring is just over 1 inch, about the top joint of a thumb.
claims: NONE. Tags are only Earrings, Edition One, KAVNAR, pre-order: no Waterproof, Tarnish Free or Hypoallergenic tag. The description says 'PVD 18K gold coating, anti-tarnish', so 'PVD 18K gold coating' can be stated as a material fact, but make no waterproof, tarnish-free, sweat-proof or hypoallergenic claim.
copyNotes: Use: 'baguette', 'clear cubic zirconia', 'channel set', 'sunburst', 'white pearl', 'pearl drop', 'it moves as you turn', '18k gold tone', 'PVD 18K gold coating', '27 mm', 'wedding function', 'quiet enough for dinner', 'hair up so the pearl swings' (the listing's styling tip), 'pre-order'. Avoid: 'diamond', 'real', 'freshwater', 'natural', 'cultured', 'Akoya' or 'South Sea' pearl (the pearl material is not stated), 'solid gold', 'gold-filled', bare 'gold' or 'silver', 'huggie', 'hoop', 'jhumka', 'chandelier', 'stud' alone (it is a drop on a post), 'waterproof', 'tarnish free', 'hypoallergenic'. In prompts avoid bare 'halo' (it pulls a round centre stone with pave around it); say 'sunburst disc of 20 radial baguettes around a small pearl'. Note: the description mentions only the hanging pearl, but every photo also shows a small pearl in the centre of the disc (2 pearls per earring), so say 'pearl at the heart and a pearl below' or don't count pearls in copy.
story: It looks like old money for Rs 1199: an Art Deco sunburst of 20 baguettes around a small pearl, with a bigger pearl swinging underneath. It's like a vintage brooch shrunk onto the ear, a 1920s ballroom, a grandmother's cocktail earrings. Its rhymes: a sun with a moon hanging off it (the light above, the pearl below), a clock face (20 stones like hour marks, the pearl ticking like a pendulum), a camera shutter or aperture, a rose window, a chandelier drop, a mirror ball, a sliced citrus wheel, a pearl coming up out of a shell. Occasion fit: wedding functions, sangeet and reception nights, cocktail dinner, sarees and satin slip dresses, hair up. The motion is the hook: the pearl swings when the head turns, so it suits video (a head turn, a pendulum, a hypnotist's watch). Best archetypes: MACRO of the sunburst disc (the 20 baguettes catch light like a rotating flare), WORN with a head turn so the pearl swings, OCCASION (bridal/festive), and swinging-pendulum motion.
variants: 1 variant: Default Title, 18k gold tone, stock 24, tagged pre-order (supplier code WE23818B). There is no rhodium silver tone option, and every photo shows the 18k gold tone. Listing photos (concept-50/refs/baguette-halo-drops/): 01 is the packshot, the pair face-on on a cream plaster cube. It shows the full construction (sunburst disc, centre pearl, 4 spokes, loop, bell cap, drop pearl) and is ref 1. 02 is a worn profile in a mustard satin slip with hair back: true scale, but the earring is small in frame, so use it to judge scale in worn shots. 03 is a macro of 1 disc tilted on the plaster: the clearest look at the 20 tapered baguettes, the bead dividers, the open window and the loop, with the drop pearl cropped and blurred. It is ref 2. 04 is the blush Naira Petite gift box (no product). 05 is the size guide: photo 01 with 14 mm and 27 mm lines and text overlaid. Don't use 05 as a reference, because the text would leak; the description's inline size-guide image was byte-identical to 05 and was not kept. ads-500 and products.md have no earlier refs or media ids for this handle, and plan.json has no lock for it, so both refs are new imports. Show the pair (01) for packshots, and 1 earring worn with hair up for worn shots.
